entities.summary: The Yuexiushan Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China, named after its location at the foot of Yuexiu Hill. It is currently mostly used for football matches and also sometimes for athletics. It is located on 34 Yingyuan Road. The stadium is owned by the Guangzhou Sports Bureau.
